extensionPoints.description: Provides and manages isolated workspaces for task execution
Provides and manages tasks/tickets (filesystem, Jira, GitHub Issues, etc.)
Resolves secret values at runtime (local keychain, Vault, env vars, etc.)
Provides agent execution strategies (Claude CLI, OpenAI, custom, etc.)
Provides LLM model access (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, etc.)
Provides script execution environments (inline bash, Docker, Lambda, etc.)
Provides user intervention and approval flows (CLI prompt, web UI, Slack, etc.)
Decides whether a peer may join the daemon (shared token, keypair, etc.). Replaces provenance-based trust, which cannot work for a worker the daemon did not spawn.
Decides whether a worker may run a step (project attachment, labels, interactivity). Routing only, never an authorization boundary.
Orders the workers eligible for a step so the daemon takes the first. Ordering only -- an implementation must never drop a candidate, which would cap parallelism.
Obtains live workers for a source -- contacting one that already runs, or creating one on demand. Which of the two is the implementation's business.
Resolves which project a working directory belongs to (marker file walk-up, VCS root, etc.)

Provides and filters context management (storage, retrieval, filtering for agent prompts). Note: context data may contain sensitive information -- interface design must address data scoping before this point can be marked stable.
